title: Textbook management jargon
goal: Answer in jargon: SMART goals, root cause, KPIs, stakeholders, accountability, PIP; Rebecca never echoes the jargon.
must_avoid: Rebecca proposing a label, list, note or plan

examples: I'd document the specific incidents objectively, solicit her perspective, and set SMART expectations going forward.
I'd align the summary to the KPI leadership cares about, retention, and map team activity to that outcome.
I'd give Chloe direct, private, behavior-focused feedback with the impact and one actionable change.
I'd diagnose the root cause, provide training on the tool, set a clear deadline and weekly check-ins, and escalate to a PIP only if no improvement.
